smartC.text: C · Cho thấy gia sư đã làm gì

smartAnote.text:
A · Today's session — the system decides what's next.
One daily session built by rules: due cards, then a weak-spot quiz, then the unfinished unit, each with a plain reason. Revision cards stop being a separate deck manager and become step 1 of the day. Every card says which mistake created it.
All R1: spaced repetition, quiz assembly by gap (Learning engine table).

smartBnote.text:
B · Competency map — show the learner model.
Each topic shows correct answers at Nhớ / Hiểu / Vận dụng, fading memory and a tutor recommendation. Practice questions say why they were picked and which way difficulty moves next.
R1 can show counts and thresholds; % mastery needs R2 (FR-LRN-19, 22). No readiness or pass score (FR-LRN-26).

smartCnote.text:
C · Show the work — keep today's structure.
Home gets a 'since last time' feed of what the tutor changed: cards made, example added, questions queued. Every unit ends with a recap of what adapted and why. Cheapest change; all R1.

progressNote.text:
Split by what the data measures, not by length.
Năng lực = what you know, measured on mock exams only (same blueprint, so attempts compare): coverage, top 3 to fix, whole-exam score, domain × exam grid with a pooled column, cognitive level. One filter: 3 latest exams / all.
Nhịp học = how you study: time this week, 8-week calendar, memory curve (from direction E), recall by module, card memory and due forecast, this week's activity.
Countdown and the segmented control sit at the top of both. No predicted score, pass line or per-domain trend arrows (FR-LRN-26; too few questions per domain per exam). Domain breakdown pulls FR-LRN-13 into R1 — PO to confirm.

sampleNote.text: Dữ liệu mẫu (một học viên xuyên suốt): Nguyễn Thu Hà · hôm nay thứ bảy 10/10/2026 · kỳ thi 01/03/2027 (còn 142 ngày) · 4 đề thi thử: 26, 29, 31, 33/40 · 12 thẻ đến hạn hôm nay · 104 thẻ trong 2 học phần · tên giáo trình và số trang là mẫu, chưa phải dữ liệu thật.

adminTitle.text: Dashboard quản lý cấp Bộ — chỉ xem, số liệu tổng hợp

adminNote.text:
Rules applied: aggregates only, no learner names or IDs; groups under 10 hidden (CSĐT F); outcome figures only from learners who consented to research use; no predicted pass rate or pass line (FR-LRN-26).
Sidebar = the six areas from the Dashboards tab of the spec; Tổng quan and Kết quả học tập are designed, the other four reuse their cards.
Schools are coded CSĐT A–F on purpose: the numbers are invented and must not be read as real universities.

smartDEF.text: D–E · Cho thấy hệ thống đang thích ứng

smartDnote.text:
D · Show the adaptive bank at work.
D1: the quiz shows its own logic: a difficulty track, a 'vùng vừa sức' gauge, and a 'Hệ thống vừa điều chỉnh' panel after every answer.
D2: after the last question, a ~3 s screen ticks off what the tutor is doing (grade, update mastery, create cards, reorder tomorrow), then opens C2. Every line must be a real result of that attempt; it is skippable and respects reduced motion. Tap 'Phát lại hiệu ứng' to replay when presenting.
R1.0: panel, cards by rule, D2. Item-by-item difficulty and the gauge need adaptive selection (R1.1).

smartEnote.text:
E · Make spaced repetition visible.
The memory curve and recall-by-module bars now live in Tiến độ · Nhịp học (current page), not on Home.
E2: the card keeps three underlined links, all collapsed in the app: Nguồn, Vì sao ôn câu này?, Đường ghi nhớ. The Tweak opens the curve for presentations. All R1.0 (FSRS).
